source_title: Virid Launches marketAgility MCP Connector, Bringing AI-Powered Store Management to eCommerce Retailers - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
New integration lets Virid clients manage products, orders, customers, and promotions through natural language in AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP-compatible platforms.
RESTON, Va. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Virid, the Unified Commerce Solutions provider, today announced the launch of the marketAgility MCP Connector, a new integration that connects marketAgility stores to leading AI platforms.
Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the open standard for connecting AI assistants to business software, the marketAgility MCP Connector works with any AI platform that supports custom MCP connectors, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT. Clients can search products, orders, and customer data, and manage catalogs, inventory, and promotions through natural language requests instead of the admin dashboard. Retailers can work in whichever AI platform their team prefers, with no custom integration to build or maintain, and the connector stays useful as the AI landscape evolves.
"AI is changing how commerce gets done, but many retailers don't have the resources to build these tools themselves," said Steve Deller, President and CEO, Virid. "The marketAgility MCP Connector puts that capability directly in our clients' hands, helping them sell faster, adapt more quickly, and grow more effectively."
How the marketAgility MCP Connector Works
Once connected, an AI assistant can search a store's products, orders, customers, shopping carts, categories, inventory, promotion codes, tax nexus records, and more. It can create or update most of these records, while orders, carts, and per-site inventory remain read-only. Users can make requests like "Find all products with SKUs starting with WDG that haven't been updated in the last 90 days" or "Create a new promotion code for 15% off, expiring at the end of the month," and review any proposed change before it's made.
The connector is available to all Virid clients with an active marketAgility store and a marketAgility account with API access. Setup takes only a few steps: add the marketAgility server URL in the AI platform's connector settings, then complete a standard marketAgility sign-in. No API tokens or technical configuration are required. Availability of custom connectors varies by AI platform and plan.
The connection uses OAuth 2.1, the industry-standard authorization flow. Users authenticate directly with marketAgility, not with the AI platform provider. The connector does not store credentials or retain store data, and all traffic is encrypted in transit. More information is available in the marketAgility / Virid privacy policy .
Retailers ready to grow their eCommerce business can contact Virid to get started. Questions, issues, or feedback about the MCP Connector can be directed to marketAgility Support .
Virid is the Unified Commerce Solution for brands ready to grow boldly and scale with confidence. By bringing together a powerful commerce platform, deep expertise, and true partnership, Virid helps growing retail brands simplify complexity and build sustained momentum. Since 1999, leading brands have trusted Virid to deliver performance, stability, and hands-on collaboration at every stage of growth.
